(01) Studio Est. 2009 Buildings, interiors, landscapes

Buildings that hold their silence.

We design calm, durable architecture for people who plan to stay. Every project begins with light, weight and time, and ends when nothing more can be removed.

Index ↓
(02) Approach

A building should get better with age. We draw slowly, test materials on site, and keep our studio small enough that the people who sketch your project are the people who finish it.

    (05) Principles

    1. 1

      Light first.

      Plans start from where the sun falls in December, not June.

    2. 2

      Fewer materials.

      Usually three. Each one honest about what it is.

    3. 3

      Built to be repaired.

      Every joint can be reached, replaced and understood in fifty years.
